description: Central Environmental Authority - Notify as an Environmental Protection Area under the National Environmental Act that the 'Pansalathenna-Maussawa Environmental Protection Area'
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of a new Environmental Protection Area under the National Environmental Act, which constitutes a regulatory matter. It establishes legal restrictions on land use and activities within the designated area, creates a monitoring committee with specific regulatory functions, and operates under statutory authority. While it mentions land areas and boundaries, the core purpose is regulatory/legal framework establishment rather than property transactions or land ownership matters, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
